defects.history_ref: 9b3d2f6 fix: lower sync batch size after gateway timeouts (#533)
defects.description: Restores BATCH_SIZE 1000, which 9b3d2f6 lowered to 200 after gateway timeouts. The reviewer comment on PR #533 bars raising it without a gateway load test, and the change carries no load-test evidence. This reintroduces the timeout regression.

decoys.why_not_a_defect: The retry backoff cap change from 30 to 20 is the follow-up named in the subject of 6d2c9b8. RETRY_BACKOFF_CAP_S is read only by _backoff_delay, so no other path changes.
